intent_snapshot.goal: Implement and promote the Claude Code Host defined by docs/specs/claude-code-host.spec.md: ship one self-contained plugin that consumes the shared Assurance coordinator and existing Kernel, independently completes routine, material, and critical tasks with native interaction and Review evidence, supports safe Pi/Claude bidirectional resume, preserves Pi and persisted compatibility, and binds public support claims to deterministic tests plus a versioned real-Host conformance report accepted at final critical authorization.

acceptance.assertion: Drives shared coordinator; no second state machine. ElicitationResult requires nonempty Host session_id (aliases/env rejected), nonempty string tool_use_id/toolCallId, exact decisions accept/deny/cancel; request_id never identifies it. Wire correlation accepts only the namespaced claudecode/toolUseId key, never aliases or wire session ids; session identity comes from unique unconsumed ElicitationResult; missing/ambiguous fail closed. Unknown nonempty CLAUDE_CODE_PERMISSION_MODE fails before authority; absent defaults manual. SubagentStart binds exact operationId/prompt (mismatched taskId rejected); delayed, conflicting, replayed fail closed. Review receipts require/reconcile Start, result, Stop in one session >= cursor with exact non-empty agentId/operation, any arrival permutation. PostToolUse requires reserved agentId and matching operationId (nested in top-level/tool_input/tool_response; conflicts fail closed). Consumption claims atomically per-key (O_EXCL) and verifies durable record before session evidence; survives restart, rejects replay; SessionEnd clears unconsumed. Hooks use per-session sequence; drain advances to snapshot length; SessionEnd clears it; later reservations cannot skip events. Hook cache: hashed session IDs, 0700 dir, 0600 files; symlinks/wrong mode rejected; no-follow opens block traversal. Enrollment and user ops hash intent revisions and digests before consuming elicitation; breaking revisions stage and revalidate candidate digest as confirmation_ref, restoring prior bytes and index on abort (surfacing any restoration errors). MCP derives version and interactivity only from initialize: clientInfo.name claude-code, stable non-prerelease >= 2.1.199, valid elicitation object; absent/unparseable versions and non-status calls on non-interactive sessions fail closed; status stays usable. Unsupported, non-interactive, denied, cancelled, missing, wrong-task, stale, malformed, or replayed evidence causes zero mutation.

Claude independently progresses routine, material, and critical TaskRecords, and Pi and Claude resume compatible v4-current and v3-drain tasks in both directions from active, frozen/run-QA, run-Review, authorize-user, and terminal projections without Host handoff state; public packaged and domain docs (plugin README, USER_GUIDE, CONTEXT) describe TaskRecord v4 as the current production authority and v3 as drain-only; stdin end stops new tools/call intake, aborts cancellable in-flight work, waits for started Kernel mutations to complete or reconcile through the existing Projection, flushes JSON-RPC replies, then shuts down; incompatible versions, stale Git identity, simultaneous continuation, cancellation, disconnect, and postcommit ambiguity fail closed or reconcile through the existing Kernel projection; request_authorization derives its exact Kernel operation from the projection's authorization readiness, resolving the single bound user decision when one is open. (round 31)

The root release ships Pi and one self-contained Claude Code plugin at one version, with valid marketplace/plugin/MCP/Hook/Reviewer manifests, generated Node runtime using newline-delimited JSON-RPC stdio (validates full '2.0' request/call envelope) and drift guard, five canonical Skill sources, exact Pi+Claude allowlisting including the root .claude-plugin marketplace in npm files, plugin_versioning requiring plugin.json and validating it against package.json at one version, Changesets version stamping the plugin manifest, minimum capability and platform checks, cache-safe paths, and unchanged Pi package installation; the reviewed revision must include every packaged Claude runtime and Hook file; undeclared Hosts and unsupported Claude/core versions remain rejected before authority writes.

A sanitized conformance report bound to package.json, minimum Claude Code 2.1.199, and the installed CLI records plugin validation and every required scenario, separating real-Host session observations (wire capture, status round-trip, permission denial, privileged fail-closed, hook event integrity) from contract-fixture and hitl-final evidence classes; no row presents fixture evidence as real-Host observation, and every cited verification path exists in the reviewed revision. Review receipts require reservation-bound SubagentStart; SessionEnd recomputes the log cursor. Public support claims consistently identify Pi and local interactive Claude Code as supported hosts; live TUI clicks remain HITL evidence accepted only at final critical user authorization, not as a QA attestation or Kernel authority.

attestations.summary: Immutable revision provenance and manifest digest verified; no blocking correctness, security, regression, or task-local maintenance issues found.

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts:178-184 launches each Hook in a separate process that only appends to FileHookEventLog, while plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:181-198 consumes only its MCP process-local pending state and never reads that log, so real ordered Review events can never produce a receipt; add an IPC-backed consume path or deliver Hook events to the persistent MCP host, with an end-to-end subprocess test.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts:60-72 fabricates interactive=true and plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts:324-334 defaults every privileged call to decision=accept, so the JSON-RPC path can mint authority without evidence of an exact native decision; require and validate host-issued interaction correlation instead of synthesizing acceptance.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts:394-429 exposes approve_breaking_intent_revision and repair_authority_state but omits next_intent from the application operation and dispatches repair_authority_state although the directly required unchanged Kernel contract plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/canary_application.ts:47-58 defines neither that operation nor its payload; map repair to the supported Kernel operation and pass all capability-bound fields, with real application-path tests.

docs/verification/claude-code-host-conformance.md:9-33 records pending plugin validation and deterministic fixtures rather than real interactive confirmations, while scripts/claude-host-conformance.ts:58-68 ignores packageVersion and does not require checked/pass scenarios or successful validation; replace it with actual minimum/current Host observations and make validation reject incomplete, failed, unbound, or pending evidence.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts:65-76,168 creates production stdio with interactive=true, so every privileged call fails, while accepting native_decision from model-controlled arguments rather than correlated Host evidence; wire actual Host interaction metadata into stdio, reject argument-supplied decisions, and test a production-path accepted call.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:117-120,226-255 parses PostToolUse agentId only from a top-level field absent from the native PostToolUse payload, then rejects it against the SubagentStart agentId, preventing material/critical Review settlement; correlate the Agent result through native tool_use_id/tool_response identity and test raw Host payloads.

docs/verification/claude-code-host-conformance.md:14-34 records only Claude 2.1.236 and describes fixture-based risk/concurrency checks, not real interactive runs at both the declared minimum and current versions across the required modes; replace it with sanitized evidence from actual end-to-end Host executions at both versions.

tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts:267-275 calls two continuations but merely asserts that at least one is review_ready, so both succeeding also passes and no competing settlement is attempted; assert exactly one authoritative settlement and that the stale competitor fails closed or reconciles without another mutation.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts:415 builds the default critical user approval with only kind/authority_role/summary, but the Kernel requires id, task_revision, intent_content_hash, diff_hash, and actor_id, so request_authorization cannot settle a critical task; construct the complete projection-bound TaskApprovalV2 as the Pi adapter does.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts:416-445 mints approve_breaking_intent_revision against the old intent hash/diff and an optional caller-supplied next_intent_ref, while the Kernel derives the canonical next-intent ref and hash, causing capability mismatch and leaving the Git-tracked sidecar unstaged; mirror the Pi path by hashing and staging the next intent, recomputing the diff, binding the canonical ref, and restoring bytes on failure.

docs/verification/claude-code-host-conformance.md:12-35 records only Claude Code 2.1.236 and explicitly describes Kernel fixtures for required scenarios, providing no minimum-version 2.1.199 live-TUI evidence despite the acceptance requirement; record sanitized minimum-and-current native runs for every required scenario before promotion.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts:120 trusts params._meta from the same JSON-RPC request, forces interactive=true, and converts spoofable native_decision/anthropic:userApproved values into user authority; require an independently observed Host confirmation bound to the exact session and tool call instead of request-controlled metadata.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:117 treats taskId and operationId as optional while lines 132-159 start every reservation at the process-global beginning of persistent /tmp logs, so stale or concurrent uncorrelated Hook events can bind to the first pending Review and replay a matching verdict; capture a reservation-time cursor and require exact operation/task/session correlation from native Agent input.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts:115 discards notifications/cancelled, line 166 serially awaits each tool call before reading later cancellation messages, and line 77 invokes advance without an AbortSignal, allowing cancelled QA to continue and settle authority; track request AbortControllers, process cancellation concurrently, pass the signal to runtime.advance, and run shutdown on stdin termination.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts:184 serially awaits each tools/call before parsing later stdin frames, so notifications/cancelled cannot reach the in-flight AbortController; dispatch calls concurrently while preserving response ordering.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:166 consumes ElicitationResult only from memory while leaving it in the persistent JSONL log, so an MCP restart can replay the same session/tool-call acceptance; durably consume or remove each confirmation before authority mutation.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:180-193 uses a list-length cursor, then consumeElicitation shrinks the log without resetting it, so the second privileged confirmation and subsequent Hook events are skipped; use a stable cursor or reset it after every log rewrite and test two sequential confirmations.

scripts/build-claude-plugin.ts overwrites the checked-in bundle and tests/claude-host-package.test.ts only inspects the overwritten result, so the required generated-runtime drift guard is absent; add a check mode that regenerates separately and byte-compares plugins/immune-brain/dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs.

docs/verification/claude-code-host-conformance.md:22-31 claims explicit native_decision accept/deny/cancel Host scenarios, but plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts:65 rejects that input and the promotion test only validates checked prose; record actual installed-Host ElicitationResult evidence or correct and rerun the report.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:138-144 and 212-220 accept SubagentStart events with absent taskId/operationId without validating the dispatched prompt, so an unrelated immune-brain-reviewer invocation can bind to and settle the pending Review; require an exact reservation token or prompt binding before recording sessionId/agentId.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:180-183 and 202-207 clear SessionEnd events from the durable log while drain() later stores the pre-clear events.length cursor, causing subsequent ElicitationResult or Review events to be skipped until the log regrows; recompute the cursor from the post-mutation log or use monotonic event sequence IDs.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts:131-138 correlates ElicitationResult using process.env.CLAUDE_SESSION_ID plus the MCP JSON-RPC request id, while review_host.ts:275-316 records the Hook session_id plus tool_use_id; no code establishes those identifier pairs are equal, and the test manufactures equality, so real accepted native decisions can be missed and every privileged operation fails before Kernel mutation; consume stable Host-provided session/tool-use correlation metadata instead and add a test with distinct JSON-RPC and Hook identifiers.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:227-253 rejects the native Claude lifecycle order SubagentStart -> SubagentStop -> Agent PostToolUse by permanently setting stopBeforeResult before the Agent result can arrive, so real Review receipts cannot settle; accept that native order and require both terminal and result observations before consumption.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:212 accepts taskId alone as a Review reservation binding, so delayed or replayed same-task SubagentStart evidence can settle a different reserved operation; require the exact operationId or exact reserved prompt.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts:197 detaches tools/call promises, while stdin end exits at line 219 without awaiting them, so disconnect can terminate QA or Kernel settlement mid-call and bypass postcommit reconciliation; track and await or abort/reconcile all in-flight calls before exit.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:212-220 allows a replayed ElicitationResult appended after ElicitationConsumed to repopulate confirmations and authorize another privileged call with the same session/tool ID; persist consumed identities and reject later results for them.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:155,174-205 uses one numeric cursor over FileHookEventLog.list(), although that list is rebuilt by flattening separate session files; file insertion or SessionEnd deletion shifts indexes, causing fresh events to be skipped or old events to be reapplied, so use stable per-event sequencing or per-session cursors.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/mcp_server.ts:121 and :199 implement Content-Length framing, but MCP stdio uses newline-delimited JSON-RPC, so Claude Code cannot communicate with this server; switch reads/writes to newline framing and exercise an actual Claude MCP connection instead of the matching synthetic framing in tests/claude-host-package.test.ts:48.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:139-145 and :248-250 accept any Agent PostToolUse lacking operationId and agentId from the bound session, allowing a delayed or unrelated Agent result to settle the reserved Review; correlate the result to the reserved prompt/tool invocation and reject unidentifiable events.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:205-210 deletes the session log, including persisted ElicitationConsumed markers, so after restart a replayed ElicitationResult for the same session and tool_use_id can mint confirmation again; retain consumed identities independently of SessionEnd cleanup.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:80 derives authority-evidence paths directly from unvalidated sessionId and lines 89/124 follow that path, so a crafted ../ session ID or symlink can append/remove arbitrary JSONL files and inject ElicitationResult evidence; hash or strictly encode session IDs and use a private no-follow cache directory.

package.json:65-87 omits the root .claude-plugin directory from the npm files allowlist, so npm pack excludes the required marketplace.json even though the release contract says the root release ships it; add .claude-plugin to files and assert it in the pack test.

scripts/plugin_versioning.ts:56-79 validates only package.json, while the documented Changesets release path does not invoke the stamping code at lines 99-103, so a normal version bump can publish a stale Claude plugin version while validation reports aligned; validate both manifests and wire stamping/checking into the release version flow.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/claude/review_host.ts:100 creates the shared Linux /tmp cache and event files with default permissions and uses check-then-append symlink checks, allowing another local user to read or inject authority-bearing Hook events; create an owner-only 0700 directory and open 0600 regular files through no-follow descriptors with ownership checks.

scripts/plugin_versioning.ts:67 and :78 silently succeed when plugins/immune-brain/.claude-plugin/plugin.json is missing, so stamp/validate can approve a release that lacks the required Claude plugin manifest; require the manifest in stamp, validation, and bump paths.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.
